trello.name: Update pricing page
trello.desc: Jordan to update the pricing page to reflect the new subscription tiers: Basic ($29/month), Pro ($49/month), and Enterprise ($99/month). Include a clear comparison of features for each tier and a prominent checkout button. This is part of the initial integration to be completed within the next two weeks.

trello.name: Implement frontend checkout process
trello.desc: Jordan to implement the frontend checkout process using Stripe Elements within the next two weeks. The checkout form must match the app's design, handle potential errors (e.g., invalid card details, insufficient funds) gracefully, and include a tooltip or help icon explaining what happens if the user chooses a different plan later on.

trello.name: Build user dashboard functionalities
trello.desc: Jordan to build the user dashboard within the next two weeks to provide current plan details and billing info, options to upgrade, downgrade, or cancel subscriptions, access to invoices and payment history, and a way to update payment methods. The dashboard should be intuitive, reflect real-time subscription status, and notify users of changes like successful upgrades or payment failures.

trello.name: Integrate Stripe API for subscriptions
trello.desc: Taylor to integrate Stripe's API on the backend within the next two weeks to handle creating and managing subscriptions, as well as processing successful and failed payments.

trello.name: Set up Stripe webhook handlers
trello.desc: Taylor to set up webhook handlers within the next two weeks for specific events: invoice.payment_succeeded (to confirm payments and activate/continue subscriptions), invoice.payment_failed (to notify users, prompt payment info update, and send email notifications), and customer.subscription.deleted (to update access rights and offer re-subscription).

trello.name: Integrate frontend with backend API
trello.desc: Jordan to integrate the frontend with the backend API within the next two weeks to ensure subscription changes are reflected in real-time on the dashboard. Handle integration errors and provide clear notifications to users for events like payment failures and subscription confirmations.

trello.name: Prepare subscription test plan
trello.desc: Taylor to prepare a detailed test plan for the testing phase (a week after the initial two-week integration) covering both manual and automated tests for the entire subscription flow, from sign-up to billing to managing the subscription. Share the test plan with Alex and Jordan.

trello.name: Create user documentation and FAQ
trello.desc: Jordan to create user documentation and support materials once everything is live, including a help section or FAQ that covers common issues and questions about managing subscriptions, accessing invoices, and handling issues.

trello.name: Document API endpoints and webhooks
trello.desc: Taylor to document the API endpoints and webhook event handlers to make future maintenance and troubleshooting easier.

trello.name: Schedule follow-up meeting
trello.desc: Alex to set up a follow-up meeting for next week to review progress on the initial integration and address any issues or blockers.
